title: Savory Pierogi with Gooey Boudin Filling
description: A unique fusion of Ukrainian pierogi with Indian spices and a gooey boudin filling, perfect for adventurous eaters.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the pierogi according to package instructions until they float to the surface.
Meanwhile, heat the ghee in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the boudin and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until no longer pink, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the garam masala, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Once the pierogi are cooked, add them to the skillet with the boudin mixture.
Toss to combine and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Optional: garnish with fresh cilantro or scallions.
